avis.titre: it's a great serum that brightens the skin, improves texture
avis.texte: The La Roche-Posay Pure Vitamin C12 Oil Control Serum is a really impressive product, especially for people with oily or combination skin who still want the benefits of vitamin C. The formula contains 12% pure vitamin C, which helps brighten the skin, improve overall texture, and soften the look of fine lines over time. It also includes salicylic acid, which gently exfoliates and helps refine pores, making the skin look smoother and less shiny. With consistent use, the skin tends to look more radiant and even. Another great aspect of this serum is how lightweight and fast-absorbing it feels on the skin. It doesn't leave a greasy finish and helps control excess oil while still giving the skin a healthy glow. It layers well with other skincare products and works nicely under sunscreen or makeup. Overall, it's a well-formulated serum that brightens, smooths, and helps balance oily skin, making it a great option for anyone looking to improve dullness while keeping shine under control.
